Fact: Person set up an illegal electric fence around farmland, without approval, no warning signs. He turned on at night, causing neighbor to be electrocuted and die. This is causing death by dangerous means. Which charge in list corresponds? Options: "危险物品肇事" (dangerous goods causing accident). "故意伤害" (intentional injury). "故意毁坏财物". "破坏计算机信息系统". Not relevant. "非法持有毒品". Not. "非法组织卖血". Not. "非法获取公民个人信息". Not. "聚众扰乱社会秩序". Not. "行贿". Not. "受贿". Not. "放火". Not. "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". Not. "诈骗". Not. "合同诈骗". Not. "保险诈骗". Not. "信用卡诈骗". Not. "金融凭证诈骗". Not. "提供侵入、非法控制计算机信息系统程序、工具". Not. "破坏广播电视设施、公用电信设施". Not. "危险物品肇事" maybe fits: using dangerous items (electric fence) causing death. In Chinese criminal law, "危险物品肇事罪" is for causing death by dangerous objects. The fact: illegal electric fence causing death. So charge: "危险物品肇事". Also possibly "故意伤害" because he intentionally turned on electricity at night, causing death. But the act may be considered "故意伤害致死" (intentional injury resulting in death). However the lexicon includes "故意伤害". That could apply. Which is more appropriate? The scenario: He set up fence, told neighbors, but no warning signs. He turned on at night. Did he intend to kill? Probably not; maybe negligence. The law may treat as "危险物品肇事罪" (dangerous goods causing accident). The lexicon includes that. So we choose that.

Any other charge? "非法持有毒品" no. So answer: [罪名]危险物品肇事<eoa>
